# Gert Lucas Roos

Official professional website: https://gertlucasroos.com/

Gert Lucas Roos, also known as Gerlu Roos, is a South African agribusiness and agricultural operations professional. His professional focus includes farm operations, agricultural production, commodity trading, procurement, logistics, transport-linked operations, project coordination, agricultural technology and business development.

## Independent agricultural recognition
Independent agricultural publications document Gerlu Roos in connection with the PIONEER Weigh and Win Eastern Region dryland maize results, including a published yield of 15.373 t/ha. The official website's agricultural recognition page links directly to the independent source material.

## Authentic agricultural photography
The Field and Agricultural Operations page contains original agricultural photography associated with Gert Lucas Roos's agricultural work, providing visual context for field operations, machinery and commercial agricultural environments.
